Overview: Mihiraki PDF Utility supports 14 languages, double-page spread views (RTL/LTR), and is specially optimized for scanned books and manga.
Opening & Saving: Tap the Open icon (or Ctrl+O) to load a PDF. Use Save (Ctrl+S) to save all pages, or Export Selected (Ctrl+E) to export selected pages.

Page Operations: Tap pages to select them. The top toolbar buttons dynamically adapt: unselected mode shows general actions (Save, Add, Settings), while selected mode unlocks editing tools (Rotate, Move, Split, Insert Blank, Delete, Export Selected).
Display Modes: Toggle between Grid and Spread views. Supports toggling between Right-to-Left (RTL) and Left-to-Right (LTR) reading directions.
Device Support: Fully optimized for smartphones, tablets, foldable devices, and desktop (ChromeOS, etc. with keyboard shortcuts & right-click).

Display & Devices: Toggle between Grid and Spread views. Supports Right-to-Left (RTL) reading mode. Fully optimized for smartphones, tablets, foldable devices, and desktop (ChromeOS, etc. with keyboard shortcuts & right-click).

Toolbar Buttons Reference:
• Open / Save / Add: Load PDFs, save all pages, append/merge PDFs.
• Selection: Select all, clear, or invert selection.
• Page Editing: Rotate, move (up/down), split, insert blank, delete, or export selected.
• View & Settings: Toggle view (grid/spread), RTL/LTR reading direction, cover layout, properties, and password security.
Properties & Metadata: Configure document title, author, subject, keywords, PDF version, and page layout.
Security & Password: Set or clear encryption passwords for saving and exporting protected PDFs.
Options & Display: Customize thumbnail image sizes (Small/Medium/Large) and button display types (Icon + Text / Icon Only / Text Only).
Support Development: Purchase one-time support items (Bronze, Silver, Gold) or redeem Google Play promo codes to support app development.
Diagnostics: Run system diagnostic tests to verify PDF processor functionality, memory usage, and sample asset accessibility.
Audit Logs: Review privacy-protected local operation and runtime error audit logs (automatically retained for 24 hours, strictly excluding personal data).
Report Issues: Use the "Problems Reported" screen to bulk copy diagnostic reports and app logs for easy troubleshooting and reporting via email or GitHub Issues.
